novel_features.name: Offline FTS over enrichment cache
novel_features.description: Search every contact or company you've previously enriched without spending a credit.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite FTS5 over the persons + companies cache; Prospeo's API has no free lookup.
novel_features.example: prospeo-pp-cli find 'VP of Sales fintech Berlin' --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the agent already has a contact in cache, re-fetching from Prospeo burns credits. find is zero-cost.

novel_features.name: Lifetime-dupe-aware cache
novel_features.description: Predict which rows in a CSV would be free Prospeo lifetime-duplicate hits before you spend credits.
novel_features.rationale: Prospeo returns free_enrichment:true for duplicates; our cache mirrors that semantics so prediction works pre-flight.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Cuts bulk-run cost by skipping cold-API trips for guaranteed-free hits.

novel_features.name: Credit pre-flight + max-cost guard
novel_features.description: Estimate the credit cost of a bulk job and refuse to run if it exceeds the budget or remaining balance.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live account-information with row count × per-row cost; aborts before the spend.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Stops accidental 10-credit-per-row mobile bursts that drain the monthly allowance.

novel_features.name: Bulk cost simulator
novel_features.description: Show projected credits, dupe-hit ratio, and ETA before sending any rows.
novel_features.rationale: Pairs row counting with cache predictions; uses no API calls.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can decide whether a job is worth running based on cost projection.

novel_features.name: Credit burn timeline
novel_features.description: Daily burn rate and projected runway from snapshots of /account-information.
novel_features.rationale: Account snapshots collected on every call build a time series Prospeo's dashboard does not surface.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells the agent when the user is on track to run out before quota renewal.

novel_features.name: Lookalike from seed
novel_features.description: Find companies (or people) similar to a seed by auto-deriving industry, size, tech-stack, and location filters from an enriched seed.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-entity reasoning: one enrich-company response becomes a multi-filter search-company query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns 'find more like this customer' into one command instead of three.

novel_features.name: Search-then-enrich pipeline
novel_features.description: Run search-person with filters, walk pages, enrich each hit (verified-only), cache everything, write CSV.
novel_features.rationale: One command composes two endpoints plus pagination plus cache writes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Replaces 25+ HTTP calls and the glue between them with one invocation.

novel_features.name: Dedup-aware CSV merge
novel_features.description: Skip rows already in an existing enriched CSV so re-runs are incremental and cheap.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-source join: input CSV × existing CSV × cache.
novel_features.example: prospeo-pp-cli person bulk --input new.csv --merge existing.csv --output merged.csv
novel_features.why_it_matters: Re-running a campaign on a refreshed lead list only burns credits on net-new rows.

novel_features.name: Per-plan rate limiter
novel_features.description: Plan-aware token bucket that slows down before tripping Prospeo's 429s.
novel_features.rationale: Reads x-daily-request-left and x-minute-request-left response headers; uses cliutil.AdaptiveLimiter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Avoids burning retries chasing the limit on a Starter or Growth plan.

novel_features.name: ICP fit scorer
novel_features.description: Score every enriched row against a YAML ICP spec (titles, sizes, geos, tech, seniority) and emit a score column with reasons.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-source join: enrichments rows × YAML rules engine.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets the agent rank a list for the SDR without paying for a separate ICP-scoring vendor.

novel_features.name: Spend-attribution ledger
novel_features.description: Report spend per CSV source, per campaign tag, or per day from the local enrichments + csv_jobs + account_snapshots ledger.
novel_features.rationale: Three-table SQLite join Prospeo's dashboard cannot do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'which file ate my credits this week' in one command.

narrative.headline: Every Prospeo endpoint, plus a credit-aware local cache, bulk CSV pipelines, and lookalike search no other Prospeo tool ships.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps the full Prospeo API with an offline SQLite cache that mirrors lifetime-dupe semantics, a credit pre-flight guard, and search-then-enrich pipelines. Designed so a single agent can run a list-build → enrich → score → CSV flow with one command and never overspend.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set PROSPEO_API_KEY from https://app.prospeo.io/api-keys. The CLI sends it as the X-KEY header on every request. Run `doctor` to verify auth and show your remaining credits.

quickstart.comment: Verify your API key and show your current plan, credits, and quota renewal date
Enrich a single person by LinkedIn URL (1 credit, free if you've enriched this person before)
Project the credit cost and dupe-hit ratio of a bulk job before spending
Run the bulk enrich with a hard budget ceiling — the CLI aborts if the projected cost exceeds 500 credits

quickstart.command: prospeo-pp-cli find 'VP of Sales fintech Berlin' --json
quickstart.comment: Search the local cache for anyone you've already enriched matching this query — zero credit cost

troubleshoots.fix: Re-export PROSPEO_API_KEY from https://app.prospeo.io/api-keys and rerun `prospeo-pp-cli doctor`
Lower --concurrency (Starter caps at 5 req/s; Growth 5; Pro 30). The built-in adaptive limiter slows down on `x-minute-request-left` headers.
Run `prospeo-pp-cli credits burn --days 14` to see your projected runway; use `--max-cost N` on bulk to fail fast before partial spend.

troubleshoots.symptom: Mobile enrichment costs 10x more than expected
troubleshoots.fix: The --mobile flag opts into the 10-credit mobile finder. Omit it for email-only (1 credit per row).

narrative.when_to_use: Use prospeo-pp-cli whenever an agent needs to enrich contacts or companies, build a B2B lead list, or look up a person by LinkedIn URL. Prefer it over hand-rolled Python scripts because the local cache makes duplicate enrichments free, the credit pre-flight stops surprise overspend, and the find command answers 'do we already have this contact?' without an API call.

recipes.title: End-to-end SDR list build
recipes.explanation: Searches Prospeo for people matching the ICP filter, walks pages until 100 hits, enriches each with a verified email, and writes a CSV ready for SmartLead.

recipes.title: Predict bulk cost before spending
recipes.explanation: Counts how many rows are guaranteed-free lifetime dupes vs. cold enrichments. Output JSON is narrowed to the four fields the agent needs.

recipes.title: Score a list against ICP and export top hits
recipes.command: prospeo-pp-cli score --icp icp.yaml --input enriched.csv --output scored.csv --json --select rows.email,rows.score,rows.score_reasons
recipes.explanation: Reads enriched.csv, applies the YAML rule set, writes scored.csv with a score column, and emits a narrowed JSON view per row for the agent to rank against.

recipes.title: Find similar customers to your best logo
recipes.explanation: Enriches the seed, derives industry + size + tech-stack filters, runs search-company, and returns the top 25 lookalikes ranked by similarity.

recipes.title: Credit-spend forensics
recipes.explanation: Joins enrichments × csv_jobs × account_snapshots; answers 'which CSV burned my credits this week' in one command.

trigger_phrases: find an email for this contact
score these leads against my ICP
how many credits do I have left
